name: Sailab Banik
statement: Software engineer with 3+ years building production full-stack and AI systems, from retrieval pipelines to the interfaces on top of them.
about: I am a software engineer at ZF Group in Chennai, three years in. I lead the frontend of PrimeAI, an internal document processing platform used by five business teams, and own features end to end — interface, API, schema, and the pipeline that ships them. Away from work I build local-first AI systems: retrieval and vision-language extraction that run entirely on infrastructure you control, so sensitive documents never leave the building.
